[[Rick (DS)|Rick]] (brother-in-law, if married to [[Popuri (DS)|Popuri]]) |appearances =[[Pete (HM)|HM]], [[Pete (GB)|GB]], [[Pete (GBC2)|GBC2]], [[Pete (GBC3)|GBC3]], [[Pete (HM64)|HM64]], [[Pete (BTN)|BTN, HMfG, B&G]], [[Pete (FoMT)|FoMT, MFoMT]], DS, Cute, [[Pete (SoSFoMT)|SoSFoMT]] }} {{Youmay|Pete, a character from [[Harvest Moon: DS|Harvest Moon DS]]|[[Pete]] in his other appearances throughout the series}} {{Nihongo|Pete|ピート|Pīto}} is the main protagonist and playable character in ''[[Harvest Moon: DS]]''. ==Story== The story begins where Pete has already inherited his family farm. One day, he saw [[Witch Princess (DS)|Witch Princess]] while walking to the Goddess Spring, complaining of how annoying the [[Harvest Goddess (DS)|Harvest Goddess]] is, especially when she appears from nowhere and says "Tadaaaaaa!" Witch Princess follows up by claiming she'll cast a spell on her to never do it again. Suddenly, the Harvest Goddess appears with some [[Harvest Sprites (DS)|Harvest Sprites]], and said exactly what annoys Witch Princess the most. Furious, Witch Princess casts a spell on her, only to realize that she accidentally used the wrong spell and has petrified the Harvest Goddess instead. When Witch Princess attempts to fix her mistakes, she manages to make things worse by teleporting her away to another world. Shortly afterwards, she sends all 101 Harvest Sprites away to see if they can find her. She quickly notices Pete saw the whole thing, telling him to work hard in order to bring them back. {{HMDSCharacters}} [[Category:Player Characters]] [[Category:Harvest Moon DS]] [[Category:Harvest Moon DS Characters]]
